episodes.title: Clawing Your Way to the Top
One Hell of an American Dream

upcomingEventText.simpleText: It's a new season of "Hell's Kitchen" and for the first time ever it's 'Battle of the Ages!' The competing chefs will face off in two teams: the 20-somethings red team versus the 40-somethings blue team.
Both teams battle it out in a challenge to elevate chicken wings, awarding the winner the coveted punishment pass. Then, Gene Simmons from the band KISS surprises the chefs at dinner service.

runs.text: Clawing Your Way to the Top

accessibilityData.label: Clawing Your Way to the Top 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Skateboarding legend Tony Hawk helps Chef Ramsay teach the chefs how to shred with precision as they are challenged to de-shell and cook lobsters.

The chefs, in their newly formed teams, go head to head in an unmerciful slip-and-slide competition, culminating in a dinner service at which one chef's knowledge and experience of the culinary world comes into question.
The chefs battle in a speed breakfast challenge, feeding a dining room of first responders. The winning team earns a day of relaxation and luxury.

accessibilityData.label: Til Chef Do Us Part 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Season 20 winner Trenton Garvey returns to get married live in Hell's Kitchen, and the chefs are tasked with creating a menu of appetizers and entrees to be served during the wedding reception.
Music is in the air as both teams battle in a relay challenge that pits each chef against another, culminating in a dinner service at which one chef's leadership comes into question.
It's all fun and games as the chefs compete in the first-ever "wild game show," which later results in five chefs going head to head in a cook-for-your-life showdown.

accessibilityData.label: Putting the Carne in Carnival 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: It's down to the top ten! The chefs meet Chef Ramsay outside for HK's Carne-Val, surprising them with carnival games for their next challenge.
Chef Ramsay and actor Danny Trejo challenge the chefs to a taco competition, culminating in an intense dinner service that comes down to a race to the finish.
Chef Ramsay brings back two favorites: the sauciest Blind Taste Test Challenge ever and a world-class charity dinner service for a host of VIPs.
Through three unique cooking challenges, the chefs will have to prove that they are the best of the best to receive the coveted black jacket.

accessibilityData.label: The Fab Five Take Flight 42 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The black jacket chefs are challenged to cook dishes with ingredients from different cities to be judged by Chef Michael Cimarusti, and then the fab final five struggle to work together in the same kitchen during dinner service.
The final four chefs compete to be featured in Entertainment Weekly. Then, Chef Ramsay tests their attention to detail with sabotages during dinner service.

accessibilityData.label: A Finale for the Ages (Part 1) 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: In the penultimate episode, the final three chefs are treated to a day of relaxation from Chef Ramsay before battling it out in front of some of the best chefs in the world.

accessibilityData.label: A Finale for the Ages (Part 2) 45 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: In an epic finale, find out who will be the head chef of Hell's Kitchen Atlantic City!

description.simpleText: In this Emmy-nominated reality series, celebrity chef Gordon Ramsay roasts hopeful restauranteurs.

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The contestants compete in the signature dish challenge after being divided into two teams.
A rocky first dinner service for both teams involves raw meat and bad communication.
Disaster strikes when raw chicken and cold steak are served.
The contestants must create elevated American comfort food dishes.

accessibilityData.label: Just Bring the Darn Fish 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: It's time for the surf-and-turf relay challenge, where the chefs will taste and identify mystery proteins.
The chefs face off in a soccer-themed fusion challenge featuring Alexi Lalas.

accessibilityData.label: All Up in Your Grills 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The chefs tackle a high-stakes barbecue challenge with Aaron Franklin as the judge.
The contestants are each assigned to cook one of the top 5 cuisines in America.

accessibilityData.label: More Bang for Your Buck 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The chefs learn that running a restaurant takes more than passion when Suzanne Goin judges their dishes.
Jordan Chiles challenges the chefs to create balanced pasta dishes for Chef Evan Funke.
A new blind taste test arises. Scallop and soufflé problems at dinner service reveal the winners and losers.

accessibilityData.label: A Hell's Kitchen Special Delivery 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Ramsay gives black jackets to the aspiring chefs. They play craps to pick dishes for the initial challenge.
After a wild night, the chefs learn how influence impacts the future.
The chefs compete in a "Hell's Kitchen" Grand Prix challenge with a twist.

accessibilityData.label: And Then There Were Two 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The "Hell's Kitchen" finale looms as the last three chefs compete to impress guest judges.

accessibilityData.label: One Hell of an American Dream 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The two finalists compete for the grand prize by creating menus and cooking for Chef Ramsay.

description.simpleText: In this Emmy-nominated reality series, celebrity chef Gordon Ramsay roasts hopeful restauranteurs.

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Eighteen talented head chefs set out to impress Gordon Ramsay in the Signature Dish Challenge.
The contestants compete in a fiery flambé challenge.
The chefs go head to head in a seafood showdown.
Michelin-starred chef Dan Barber joins Gordon to judge a pickling challenge.
The chefs must put great burgers together using wild ingredients.
The chefs feel the heat when faced with a pasta challenge.
The chefs must balance an array of ingredients and create a dish that really sings.
The chefs must communicate with efficiency in a secret ingredient challenge.
The chefs are challenged to finish dishes using verbal cues.
The chefs face a walk down memory lane and the blind taste test.

accessibilityData.label: A Soap Opera in Hell 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Emmy winner Susan Lucci attends the kitchen's charity night.
The contestants pull out all the stops to secure a black jacket.

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The top five try to make professional chefs out of comedians.
The top four chefs cook for Foxwoods chefs and executives.

accessibilityData.label: One Hell of a Ride 43 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The top three create showstopping five-course meals.
The two finalists compete in one last dinner service.
